programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT S2
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY START A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! From building BU INAH'S dream food stall, dealing with the lively antics of their neighbor CEU KOKOM, to PAK SOMAT'S efforts to become an online motorcycle taxi driver for his family. A heartwarming story filled with laughter and moral lessons, suitable for all ages.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 23: THE JOURNEYS
programme.desc: POKEMON JOURNEYS IS A POKEMON ANIME SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF A POKEMON TRAINER NAMED ASH KETCHUM AND HIS FRIEND, GOH. THEY JOURNEY ACROSS VARIOUS POKEMON REGIONS TO CHASING THEIR DREAMS. IN THEIR ADVENTURES, THEY MEET LEGENDARY POKEMON, BATTLE AGAINST POWERFUL TRAINER, AND LEARN MANY NEW THINGS ABOUT POKEMON. THE STORY FOCUS ON THE FRIENDSHIP, ADVENTURE, AND CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT BRINGING BY THEIR JOURNEY IN THE WORLD OF POKEMON.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: Suami Idola Membawa Petaka
programme.desc: A marriage that was once peaceful changes completely when a series of terrifying threats begin to emerge. Rima and Haikal’s once-harmonious and happy marriage suddenly turns into a nightmare. Their joyful life takes a drastic turn as terrifying incidents begin to haunt their household.

programme.title: Musuh Di Balik Selimut
programme.desc: In his family’s eyes, Hengki is a romantic and faithful husband. He is also trusted to manage the business owned by his wife and in-laws. However, behind his wife Raisa’s back, Hengki secretly cheats on her and frequently takes money from the store.

programme.title: Rahasia Dibalik Akun Palsu
programme.desc: Watch Today's Special True Story.

programme.title: Merangkai Kisah Indah
programme.desc: Each episode features true or fictional tales that convey values of kindness, love, and friendship, inviting viewers to reflect and appreciate the beautiful moments in life.

programme.title: D'Academy S8
programme.desc: D'Academy Season 8 is Indonesia's premier dangdut singing talent competition, bringing together the country's most promising singers from across the archipelago.

programme.title: Operation Red Sea
programme.desc: PLA Navy Marine Corps launch a hostage rescue operation in the fictional Republic of Ihwea and undergo a fierce battle with rebellions and terrorism.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China
programme.desc: Legendary martial arts hero Wong Fei-Hung fights against foreign forces' plundering of China. When Aunt Yee arrives back from America, Wong Fei-Hung assumes the role of her protector.

programme.title: Mujizat Masih Ada
programme.desc: It tells stories that are full of moral and religious messages, often focusing on miracles that happen in someone's life because of faith, prayer, and kindness.

programme.title: Fokus Pagi
programme.desc: Fokus Pagi is a morning news program on Indosiar that delivers the latest news from across Indonesia, covering national events, crime, disasters, and social and economic issues, presented concisely to give viewers a quick overview at the start of the day.

programme.title: Merangkai Kisah Indah
programme.desc: Each episode features true or fictional tales that convey values of kindness, love, and friendship, inviting viewers to reflect and appreciate the beautiful moments in life.

programme.title: Dil
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a romance that blossoms between two young people from different backgrounds.

programme.title: Kaho Naa Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: A young girl meets the doppelganger of her deceased boyfriend and now has a chance to find the people who have murdered him.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Sementara beberapa anggota keluarga memperlakukannya dengan baik, yang lain terus-menerus menghina dan meremehkannya.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: A smart journalist Reet and hot-headed Raghav enter an arranged marriage through the 'Aata Sata' custom to secure their siblings' happiness. Their relationship of convenience faces unexpected turns.

programme.title: Jodoh Wasiat Bapak Reborn
programme.desc: Adinda, a forensic doctor with a supernatural ability to see the past through corpses, must fulfill her late father's wishes. Alongside a detective and an architect, she uncovers mysteries surrounding the dead and her father's mysterious death.

programme.title: Bernapas Dalam Kubur
programme.desc: After a pregnant woman is murdered, her spirit seeks revenge against her increasingly terrified killers, who are determined to finish her off for good.

programme.title: Balada Cinta Angling Dharma
programme.desc: Anglingdarma's wife burns herself alive after he refuses to teach her how to communicate with animals. A guilty Anglingdarma transforms into a whistling duck to travel the world to repent of his sins.

programme.title: Scared
programme.desc: A big group of freshman students go out of town. On the journey, their bus has to cross a creaky old river bridge which is the only way to get to the center of a dark forest. When the bus is halfway across, the bridge collapses and the bus falls deep into the river more than 50 meters from the surface. Nearly all the students are killed. The remaining students walk into the forest until they discover a mysterious, abandoned town. The students are cruelly murdered one by one. Only the survivor will be able to explain it all.

programme.title: Hati Ke Hati Bersama Mamah...
programme.desc: The ANTV program “Hati Ke Hati Bersama Mamah Dedeh” is a well-known religious talk show, particularly among Muslim women in Indonesia. This religious program thoroughly explores family issues in everyday life, discussing them from an Islamic perspective.

programme.title: Bhediya
programme.desc: Set in the forests of Arunachal, Bhediya is a story of Bhaskar, a man who gets bitten by a wolf, and begins to transform into the creature. As Bhaskar and his buddies try to find answers, a bunch of twists, turns, and laughs ensue.

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are in a protracted conflict over the possession and ownership of "Yummy" a chocolate-hazelnut spread that looks like Nutella. Many foibles ensue.

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster takes viewers into a virtual world full of exciting adventures and action. Each episode features characters facing thrilling challenges, solving puzzles, and overcoming obstacles to achieve their goals

programme.title: Haikyu!! The Movie
programme.desc: Shouyou Hinata, after losing to Kitagawa Daiichi Junior High's setter Tobio Kageyama in his first official volleyball match, transfers to Karasuno High, intent on finally having a proper volleyball team and getting his revenge on Kageyama. Upon arrival at Karasuno, however, Hinata finds out Kageyama has also gone to Karasuno. Initially at odds with each other, the two form an oddball combination and fight together with the other members of the volleyball club. Karasuno reunites with a former rival school, Nekoma High, in a practice match and reignites their school rivalry.

programme.title: Ijin, Ndan!
programme.desc: The program “Ijin, Ndan!” presents reports on criminal events with a relaxed and contextual approach. This program presents actual crime facts from a perspective that is closer to everyday life.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: The story of Trang Quynh, a clever and cunning boy known for his intelligence in dealing with difficult situations and defeating unjust powerful figures.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT S2
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY START A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! From building BU INAH'S dream food stall, dealing with the lively antics of their neighbor CEU KOKOM, to PAK SOMAT'S efforts to become an online motorcycle taxi driver for his family. A heartwarming story filled with laughter and moral lessons, suitable for all ages.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (PORORO CYBERSPACE ADVENTURE)
programme.desc: While Pororo and his friends are having fun playing, they suddenly get pulled into the cyber world! Now, they must become superheroes to rescue Princess Petty from the villain's captivity and find their way back home.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 23: THE JOURNEYS
programme.desc: POKEMON JOURNEYS IS A POKEMON ANIME SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF A POKEMON TRAINER NAMED ASH KETCHUM AND HIS FRIEND, GOH. THEY JOURNEY ACROSS VARIOUS POKEMON REGIONS TO CHASING THEIR DREAMS. IN THEIR ADVENTURES, THEY MEET LEGENDARY POKEMON, BATTLE AGAINST POWERFUL TRAINER, AND LEARN MANY NEW THINGS ABOUT POKEMON. THE STORY FOCUS ON THE FRIENDSHIP, ADVENTURE, AND CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT BRINGING BY THEIR JOURNEY IN THE WORLD OF POKEMON.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS

PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.desc: Torpedo (also known as U-235) follows a team of Belgian resistance fighters during World War II who are assigned a near-impossible mission: steal a German U-boat loaded with uranium from the Belgian Congo and deliver it safely to the United States for the Manhattan Project. Pursued relentlessly by Nazi forces, the crew must survive enemy attacks, deception, and the unforgiving dangers of submarine warfare. Inspired by historical events, the film combines intense action with suspense and wartime drama.

programme.desc: Set to reclaim her fiancé's heart, Sanjana (Kajol) decides to travel back to India, not knowing that fate has something else planned for her.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Sementara beberapa anggota keluarga memperlakukannya dengan baik, yang lain terus-menerus menghina dan meremehkannya.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: A smart journalist Reet and hot-headed Raghav enter an arranged marriage through the 'Aata Sata' custom to secure their siblings' happiness. Their relationship of convenience faces unexpected turns.

programme.title: Jodoh Wasiat Bapak Reborn
programme.desc: Adinda, a forensic doctor with a supernatural ability to see the past through corpses, must fulfill her late father's wishes. Alongside a detective and an architect, she uncovers mysteries surrounding the dead and her father's mysterious death.

programme.title: Si Manis Jembatan Ancol
programme.desc: Maryam, a woman who are looking for happiness when her love life with Roy is in the verge of destruction. The presence of Yudha are able to make Maryam calm. But, a tragedy happened.

programme.title: Low Season
programme.desc: A girl with a special sense and can see the ghosts broke up with her boyfriend becoming tired of the big city and decided to leave the city for a break. She heads to the faraway resort in the North alone during the so-called "Low Season".

programme.title: Hati Ke Hati Bersama Mamah...
programme.desc: The ANTV program “Hati Ke Hati Bersama Mamah Dedeh” is a well-known religious talk show, particularly among Muslim women in Indonesia. This religious program thoroughly explores family issues in everyday life, discussing them from an Islamic perspective.

programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul looks after his spoilt nephews, Sunny and Vicky, and niece, Munni. When they go to a funfair, they meet Vyjayanti, who has run away from home, and decide to shelter her without Rahul's consent.

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are in a protracted conflict over the possession and ownership of "Yummy" a chocolate-hazelnut spread that looks like Nutella. Many foibles ensue.

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster takes viewers into a virtual world full of exciting adventures and action. Each episode features characters facing thrilling challenges, solving puzzles, and overcoming obstacles to achieve their goals

programme.title: David Backkom: Mars Mission
programme.desc: In order to regain recognition, the most unlucky agent, Backkom Bear, sneaked into the Mars mission, but unexpectedly broke into the mysterious world of Mars and became friends with the Martian monster he wanted to capture. Between the honor of an agent and friendship, he will face an unprecedented test.

programme.title: Ijin, Ndan!
programme.desc: The program “Ijin, Ndan!” presents reports on criminal events with a relaxed and contextual approach. This program presents actual crime facts from a perspective that is closer to everyday life.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: The story of Trang Quynh, a clever and cunning boy known for his intelligence in dealing with difficult situations and defeating unjust powerful figures.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT S2
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY START A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! From building BU INAH'S dream food stall, dealing with the lively antics of their neighbor CEU KOKOM, to PAK SOMAT'S efforts to become an online motorcycle taxi driver for his family. A heartwarming story filled with laughter and moral lessons, suitable for all ages.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (UNJUK BAKAT SAHABAT KATURI)
programme.desc: At a spirited secondary school, a group of friends including Katuri, a shy but gifted student decide to participate in the “School Talent Show”.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 23: THE JOURNEYS
programme.desc: POKEMON JOURNEYS IS A POKEMON ANIME SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF A POKEMON TRAINER NAMED ASH KETCHUM AND HIS FRIEND, GOH. THEY JOURNEY ACROSS VARIOUS POKEMON REGIONS TO CHASING THEIR DREAMS. IN THEIR ADVENTURES, THEY MEET LEGENDARY POKEMON, BATTLE AGAINST POWERFUL TRAINER, AND LEARN MANY NEW THINGS ABOUT POKEMON. THE STORY FOCUS ON THE FRIENDSHIP, ADVENTURE, AND CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT BRINGING BY THEIR JOURNEY IN THE WORLD OF POKEMON.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS

PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Oddbods

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life follows the Zhao family, owners of a century-old soy sauce business built on tradition and hard work. As the aging patriarch searches for a successor, his children become entangled in complicated relationships, family rivalries, business conflicts, and personal ambitions. Amid romance, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption, every family member must decide whether to preserve their family's legacy or pursue their own dreams. Through its emotional storytelling, the series celebrates perseverance, forgiveness, and the enduring strength of family bonds.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef is one of Taiwan's most popular cooking variety shows, produced by Sanlih E-Television. Viewers can learn practical recipes, professional cooking techniques, and kitchen tips while enjoying lighthearted entertainment and appearances by popular Taiwanese celebrities.

programme.title: Pro On Their Speciality

Along the way, it showcases local culture, regional specialties, hidden destinations, and inspiring success stories, offering an engaging look at Taiwan's diverse communities and industries.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
